Entitlement_Rules.title: Sales & Marketing Automation | Service-level entitlement rules
Entitlement_Rules.note: No forced upstream subscriptions. Authorizations, minimum scope, budget, consent and approval controls remain mandatory.

rows.Required supplied input: Industry, geography, approved public/licensed sources, strategic questions
rows.Required provider / permission: Authorized market data/search APIs or client documents
rows.Approval gate: Approve source rights and material claims; no restricted scraping
rows.Missing prerequisite behavior: Draft-only/task-only or hold when required authorization/data unavailable
rows.Revocation behavior: Revoke new executions; pause/resolve active runs safely; retain audit and lawful export
rows.Approval status: Pending product owner, legal, provider and technical approval

rows.Required supplied input: Business capabilities; offerings; target organization profile; geography; permitted sources
rows.Required provider / permission: Licensed or permitted discovery sources; user imports accepted
rows.Approval gate: Approve sources and commercial capability; no irrelevant acquisition
rows.Missing prerequisite behavior: Draft-only/task-only or hold when required authorization/data unavailable
rows.Revocation behavior: Revoke new executions; pause/resolve active runs safely; retain audit and lawful export
rows.Approval status: Pending product owner, legal, provider and technical approval

rows.Required supplied input: Organization or client contact list; purpose; source permissions; desired roles
rows.Required provider / permission: Authorized business directory or verification API; no restricted scraping
rows.Approval gate: Review uncertain identities and eligibility; no contact resale

Service_Catalog.title: Sales & Marketing Automation | 50-field service specification
Service_Catalog.note: Preserved original 30 fields; added 20 lifecycle, interoperability, execution and governance fields. One row per purchasable SKU.

rows.Sub-automation name:
SM-SVC-01-WF01 Market and demand monitoring
SM-SVC-01-WF02 Competitor and geographic intelligence
SM-SVC-01-WF03 Trend report and evidence refresh
SM-SVC-01-WF04 Emerging market signal and scenario monitoring
rows.Business objective: Track markets, demand, competitors, industry signals and geographic expansion opportunities
rows.Detailed functionality: Market and demand monitoring; Competitor and geographic intelligence; Trend report and evidence refresh; Emerging market signal and scenario monitoring; shared evidence and exception handling.
rows.Applicable industries: All authorized sectors; B2B, D2C and institutional market research
rows.Supported channels: Permitted research sources, private alerts
rows.Trigger types: Manual; scheduled or scoped business event where applicable; authorized webhook for provider events.
rows.Required input data: Industry, geography, approved public/licensed sources, strategic questions
rows.Expected output: Evidence-linked market signals, competitor updates and trend reports
rows.Workflow steps:
1. Retrieve allowed signals; classify demand; compare freshness; cite evidence
2. Compare approved public evidence; flag changes; produce regional analysis
3. Aggregate dated observations; distinguish facts and estimates; draft report for review
4. Detect material changes; compare scenarios; verify evidence; alert owner
rows.Prerequisite automations: Included foundation; no mandatory upstream paid service; optional input producers: None; authorized equivalent input accepted.
rows.Automation operating mode: AI-assisted / supervised; controlled autonomous only for preapproved eligible routine steps; simulation has zero external effects.
rows.Human approval requirements: Approve source rights and material claims; no restricted scraping
rows.Related API operations: GET /api/v1/sources; GET /api/v1/research/plans; POST /api/v1/research/plans; GET /api/v1/research/results; GET /api/v1/research/runs/{id}; ADAPTER Public web search; GET /api/v1/market/competitors; POST /api/v1/admin/competitor-sources
rows.Related database entities: growth_source; growth_source_policy; growth_source_record; growth_evidence; growth_competitor; growth_market_event
rows.Open-source software requirements: Python; Django REST Framework; PostgreSQL; Celery / Beat; Valkey; pgvector if needed; approved extraction libraries
rows.External provider requirements: Authorized market data/search APIs or client documents
rows.Estimated execution cost: See Cost Model: scenario-only internal INR per workflow invocation; provider fees, retry, storage and human labor excluded. Pricing TBD.
rows.Subscription pricing model: Proposed monthly base entitlement + metered excess per market research batch; annual option; provider charges/managed service separately quoted. Price TBD.
rows.Usage limits: Illustrative pilot: 100 market research batch(s)/month; 1 concurrent run; configurable hard budget, provider quota and frequency limits. Not approved.
rows.Full / partial / selective availability: Full suite / Research & Lead Intelligence bundle / selective (1 SKU); entitlement and usage approval required.
rows.Security and compliance requirements: Tenant + startup scope; capability and entitlement checks per action; minimum data access; audit; budget reservation; idempotency; suppression where applicable. Commercial only; comply with channel, data and advertising permissions; no private fundraising.
rows.Performance KPIs: Evidence-linked findings ≥95%; stale-source flags 100%
rows.Acceptance test references: SM-SVC-01-WF01-AT01; SM-SVC-01-WF02-AT01; SM-SVC-01-WF03-AT01; SM-SVC-01-WF04-AT01; SM-SVC-01-ENT-AT01; related UI references: A015; A016; A085; A086
rows.Implementation and verification status: 2031 target service; existing specifications/prototypes not live proof; all current acceptance scenarios Not run.
rows.Independent purchase justification: Standalone outcome: Market & Competitive Intelligence Automation; client may supply equivalent authorized inputs rather than buy upstream services.
rows.Measurable customer outcome: Evidence-linked market signals, competitor updates and trend reports; accepted against KPI and evidence, not a guaranteed business outcome.
rows.Shared execution engine: Research and evidence; Workflow orchestration; Governance
rows.Required service entitlements: SM-SVC-01 + foundation; tenant/startup, capability, role, channel/provider and budget checks at every action
rows.Agent identity and authority: Scoped service principal or authorized delegated user; deny privilege escalation; short-lived grants; no shared credentials
rows.External agent interoperability: Optional authorized connector; external agent access disabled unless explicitly granted
rows.Model portability: Provider-neutral model adapter; rules-first; quality/cost gate; no vendor lock-in assumed
rows.Event and trigger schema: Proposed event envelope: event_id, tenant_id, startup_id, service_id, workflow_revision, input_ref, occurred_at, correlation_id; validate schema and reject mismatched scope
rows.External side-effect classification: Internal analysis/draft; no external action without separate authorization
rows.Idempotency and conflict policy: Idempotency key = scoped event + workflow revision + action target; check duplicate side effects, conflicts, active reply/suppression and budget reservation
rows.Escalation and recovery policy: Bounded retry for safe failures; reconcile uncertain external outcome before retry; pause, route reviewer and log; emergency stop
rows.Data provenance requirements: Authorized source ID, owner, scope, observed_at, evidence hash/version, permitted use, freshness; hold stale/conflicting evidence
rows.Simulation and benchmark reference: SM-SVC-01-ENT-AT01 and SM-SVC-01-WF01..04-AT01; synthetic dry run and measured benchmark pending
rows.Unit economics and margin target: Unit economics pending actual provider/labor/retry costs; quote subscription + usage; margin target TBD by owner
rows.Technology and regulatory readiness: Proposed; test and validate customer demand, provider access and economics
rows.Service migration and deprecation policy: Stable IDs; version and review material changes; immutable active-run snapshot; no silent downgrade; notify subscribers and map entitlements before migration
